method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 124, compilation date 1 July 2026 (amendments to Act No. 73, 2025), register id C2026C00331; formulas lost from the text deposit (Sch 1 cl 35B; Sch 2 cll 3(2), 3A(4), (5)) transcribed from the authorised Word rendering of the same compilation in ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00490.formulas.md (2026-10-21); no instrument deposited (Child Care Subsidy Minister's Rules 2017 and the s 4 vaccination schedules not deposited); rates as printed, indexed under Schedule 4, taken as inputs; and, in fa-2006-maternity.l4 only (REQ-0062, 2026-10-22), the compilation in force on 30 August 2006, register id C2006C00402 (no compilation number; prepared 1 July 2006, amendments to Act No. 82 of 2006; in force 1 July to 27 September 2006), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00490.2006-07-01.txt, rates as printed taken as inputs
